name: a status toast confirms the job finished safely
looks: Beneath the closed device, a small rounded toast card slides up with an icon, a short status line, and a reassuring caption underneath, under a headline about the work finishing on its own schedule.
build: glass-ui-flow's toast pattern: the card slides up and fades in on power3.out, the icon doing a small settle pulse as it lands.
sound: A soft confirming chime as the toast lands.
prompt: Slide up a small rounded status toast beneath a hero product shot, with an icon, a short confident status line, and a one-line reassurance underneath. Use it as the final proof beat that the product's promise held, right before the close.
